obligations.description: - `OpenCode_Coverage_Matrix.md` and `OpenCode_Deep_Extraction.md` now pin more exact OpenCode limits: session identity must stay provider-native, SSE correlation fields remain under-specified, and requested/effective identity parity is still weaker for server-bridged providers than for direct providers.
exact_items: - `OpenCode_Coverage_Matrix.md` and `OpenCode_Deep_Extraction.md` now pin more exact OpenCode limits: session identity must stay provider-native, SSE correlation fields remain under-specified, and requested/effective identity parity is still weaker for server-bridged providers than for direct providers.
